posts.text:
“Stochastic parrots” is not my term (it’s @emilymbender’s). 

But a lot of people today commenting on it are confused.

To some extent (though I don’t think it’s a perfect metaphor, and have said that before), pure LLMs *are* like stochastic parrots.

But Astra almost certainly is NOT a pure LLM. (Note that OpenAI has not released any details.) 

My position has always been that LLMs would be part of the solution but not all of the solution, and that we need neurosymbolic computations as well.
